name: Mokingran Jewellery Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Mokingran Jewellery Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in design, production, wholesale, and retail of jewellery in the People's Republic of China, North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and internationally. It is also involved in the production and sales of K-gold jewellery, diamond inlaying jewellery, and other products and services; diamond wholesale; and jewellery testing. The company offers its products through an offline network consisting of franchise stores and self-operated stores, as well as e-commerce platforms. Mokingran Jewellery Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Tianjin, the People's Republic of China.
